title: Fairy with Flaming Torch
description: A woman with large golden butterfly wings stands in shallow surf at sunset, holding a burning torch aloft. She wears a purple and orange outfit with a floral crown, surrounded by melting clocks, jellyfish, and a stone tower overgrown with vines under a dramatic stormy sky.
prompt: A beautiful woman with large glowing golden butterfly wings stands in the ocean surf at sunset, holding a flaming torch high with both hands. She wears a form-fitting orange and purple outfit with a flower crown. A stone watchtower covered in green vines sits on a rocky island behind her. Melting clocks are scattered on the sand and rocks. Glowing jellyfish float in the water. Lightning strikes in the purple stormy sky as a large red sun sets over the ocean.
